_comment: kioskd's release trust store. The ONE public key here is byte-identical to install.DefaultSelfUpdatePublicKey — the anchor compiled into the daemon and used by the self-updater to verify what it downloads. Candidate validation and device verification therefore answer to the same authority: a release this store accepts is a release the fleet will accept, and one it rejects cannot be published. Keeping two separate keys here would let a candidate validate while every device refused it.
